test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the median of a data is 24.12 less than its mode, then the median of the data exceeds its mean by ______ (Use the empirical formula to find the answer)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Empirical formula: **Mode − Mean = 3 × (Median − Mean)**

Also, **Mode − Median = 2 × (Median − Mean)**

Given **Mode − Median = 24.12**

Required value = **Median − Mean = 24.12 ÷ 2 = 12.06**

**∴ The correct answer is 12.06.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Mode − Median = 24.12**

**Formula Used:** **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3b036e8f3558ef4c30634e477e395531e62c3db09ad508580141374ae5b7d34.png] 

⇒ **Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean**

⇒ Subtracting **Median** from both sides:

⇒ **Mode − Median = (3 Median − 2 Mean) − Median**

⇒ **Mode − Median = 2 Median − 2 Mean**

⇒ **Mode − Median = 2 × (Median − Mean)**

⇒ **24.12 = 2 × (Median − Mean)**

⇒ **Median − Mean = 24.12 ÷ 2**

⇒ **Median − Mean = 12.06**

**∴ The correct answer is 12.06.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is: **Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean**.

Symmetrical Distribution

In a perfectly **symmetrical distribution**, the **Mean, Median, and Mode** are all equal (Mean = Median = Mode).

Skewness

If **Mean > Median > Mode**, the data is **positively skewed**. If **Mode > Median > Mean**, the data is **negatively skewed**.</p
